title: Cooling Extreme Heat
description: Covers passive cooling (blocking sun, ventilation, cutting internal heat), fans, evaporative cooling, and cold-water immersion, plus hydration, clothing, and sleeping in heat. Includes protecting children, elders, and pets, treating heat exhaustion and heat stroke, and when to go to a cooling center.
shortDescription: Keep your home and body cool without AC, and treat heat illness
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
